name: catswap
docs: catswap Solana/Rust implementation.
Design sources (docs/):
- design-philosophy.md: unified balance sheet, UA, depth tier, accumulators, LP protection
- ts-completion-audit.md: what the TS reference implements / lacks
- solana-account-mapping-draft.md: PDA + instruction mapping (@codex draft)
Phase 0-2B status: math/ has 12 modules (2,300+ lines, 474 vectors);
Phase 1 instructions (initialize/mint/swap/burn/claim) + Phase 2A Margin
(open/close_margin) are code gate PASS; Phase 2B settle_funding +
initialize_perp are code gate PASS; perp_risk.rs is code gate PASS;
open_perp/close_perp/liquidate_perp + deposit/withdraw are in progress.
See README.md for full phase status and docs/phase2b-spec-checklist.md
for Phase 2B perp/funding/liquidation spec (baseline PASS).

unambiguous sentinel.

(no new buys; settlement still pending) → OPTION_STATUS_SETTLED
(settle price frozen; positions may settle). SETTLED is terminal.

accrue here and settlements are paid out of here (W3 waterfall).
Custody: `usdc_vault` is an SPL token account whose authority is THIS
vault PDA (no admin withdrawal path exists — same INV-14 discipline as
the terminal vaults). Its address is pinned deterministically at vault

itself is created lazily by fund_option_writer (terminal chunk-5 lesson:

`total_reserve + new_reserve > usdc_vault_balance × cap_bps / 10_000`
(spec §4; the base is the vault TOKEN BALANCE, not total_reserve);
0 default = no buy capacity until governance sets params.
- `spread_bps`: premium spread over theoretical price (≤ 1_000).
- `close_secs`: series close-out window before expiry.
Invariants:
- `total_reserve` = Σ `reserve_contrib` over all live OptionPositions of
this pool's series (spec §4 per-position accounting — LIABILITY side,
the worst-case reserved payout). It is NOT a mirror of the token
balance: funding does not change it, buys increase it, settlement
releases it symmetrically (W3 waterfall; checked_add/checked_sub only).
- Solvency by construction: `total_reserve ≤ usdc_vault_balance ×
cap_bps / 10_000` must hold after every buy (W3 enforces).

Single signed funding accumulator (E18). Advanced by the settle

perfect balance stays free. Default 1 = 1bp/8h ≈ 10.95% APR, the
mainstream interest-floor baseline (Binance/OKX/HL 0.01%/8h).

fields.name: fundingCurveCoeffBps
docs: Curve quadratic coefficient (integer bps per 8h) on imb². The top
at imb=100% is floor + coeff BY CONSTRUCTION (no separate cap
field — one bound is enough). Default 29 is derived, not picked:

rebalancer whole for a 15bp entry cost in 4h; replay recalibrates.

depth tier 5) deploy c=29, shallower pools c=60.

(three-coefficient family, 2026-10-02): rate adds a×imb between the
floor and the quadratic term; the top at imb=100% becomes
floor + a + c. The SAME squared cold-start ramp multiplies a and c
(pool-size damper on the whole curve). Default 0 = legacy curve v2
behavior bit-identically; mature deep pools deploy e.g. a=10.

accounts.name: ReferralRedirect
docs: Referral redirect PDA — seeds `[b"ref_redirect", from]` (task #112).
Lets an original referrer (A) redirect all future commission and the
claimable balance to a new address (B) in one write. The redirect is
**global** (not per-pool): every pool's fee path resolves
`effective_referrer = redirect(from) ?? from`, so all pools route to B.
Rules (v1):
- Only the original referrer (A) can create it (A signs).
- Revocation requires A + B dual-sign.
- Single hop resolution: `resolve_referral_target` never re-resolves the
result, so a chain formed later (A→B, then B→C) cannot misroute — A's
commission stays at B, B's own referrees go to C. `create` only checks
that the target has no redirect at creation time (no reverse index
exists to forbid a redirect being created afterwards); that is
sufficient because routing is single-hop by construction.
- After creation, A cannot claim; B claims A's accrued balance via a
redirect-aware `claim_referral_earnings`.
